name: github-merge-helper-ext
description: Firefox extension that asks Claude to review or write the commit message when merging a GitHub PR

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint -s dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist -f nightly --start-url https://github.com/whatwg/html/pulls
